mainEntity.name: My fridge is warm. What should I check before I call?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check that it is plugged in and the door is closing fully, and look for a tripped switch. Keep the doors shut, put meat and dairy in a cooler with ice, and note the brand, model and any error code.
